item.title: WordPress Gas/Electricity Bill Comparison System
item.description:
30-250 AUD | Job Title WordPress Developer – Electricity & Gas Bill Comparison System
We are looking for an experienced WordPress/PHP developer to build a custom electricity and gas comparison system for our website.
Project Overview
Customers will upload their electricity or gas bill as a PDF. The system will automatically read the bill, extract key information, compare it against energy plans stored in our database, and recommend the cheapest or best-value plans.
The system should be built as a custom WordPress plugin.
Main Features
- PDF electricity/gas bill upload - AI/PDF bill data extraction - Customer confirmation of extracted bill details - Electricity plan comparison - Gas plan comparison - Estimated annual cost and savings - Top recommended plans displayed clearly - Customer lead capture - WordPress admin dashboard - Retailer and tariff management - Mobile responsive design
Bill Information to Extract
The system should identify:
- Electricity or gas - Current retailer - Plan name - NMI / MIRN - Postcode - Billing period - Billing days - Electricity usage in kWh - Gas usage in MJ - Peak / shoulder / off-peak usage - Controlled load - Solar export - Supply charge - Usage rates - Solar feed-in tariff - Demand charges - Total bill amount
If the AI cannot identify a value confidently, it should not guess. The customer should be able to review and edit the extracted information before comparison.
Electricity Comparison
The calculator should support:
- Single-rate tariffs - Time-of-use - Peak, shoulder and off-peak - Controlled load - Solar feed-in tariffs - Demand charges - Daily supply charge - Discounts - Credits - Fees
The AI should only extract bill information. The actual price comparison must use a proper mathematical calculation engine.
Gas Comparison
Support:
- Daily supply charge - Gas usage in MJ - Flat usage rates - Block rates - Discounts - Credits
Results Page
Show plans ranked from cheapest to most expensive.
Example:
| Retailer | Plan | Annual Cost | Saving |
| Retailer A | Saver Plan | $1,650 | $480/year | | Retailer B | Value Plan | $1,720 | $410/year |
Customers should be able to click:
- Choose This Plan - Request a Callback - Email Comparison
WordPress Admin
Admin users should be able to add, edit and deactivate:
- Retailers - Electricity plans - Gas plans - Supply charges - Usage rates - Time-of-use rates - Demand rates - Controlled-load rates - Solar feed-in tariffs - Discounts - Credits - Plan expiry dates
Admin should also be able to view:
- Uploaded bills - Comparisons - Customer leads - Selected plans
CRM
Preferably integrate with HubSpot CRM so customer details and comparison results can automatically create or update a lead.
This can be completed as a later milestone if required.
Preferred Technology
- WordPress - Custom WordPress plugin - PHP - MySQL - JavaScript - WordPress REST API - OpenAI API or similar AI service - PDF extraction technology
Security
The system must include:
- Secure PDF uploads - File-type and file-size validation - Input sanitisation - Secure API keys - Protection against malicious uploads - Secure bill storage - Ability to automatically delete uploaded bills if required
Deliverables
The successful freelancer will provide:
- Complete WordPress plugin - Full source code - Database structure - Bill upload system - AI bill extraction - Electricity calculator - Gas calculator - Admin dashboard - Comparison results page - Lead management - Installation on our website - Testing - Basic documentation
Suggested Milestones
Milestone 1: WordPress plugin, database and admin dashboard Milestone 2: Electricity comparison calculator Milestone 3: PDF/AI bill extraction Milestone 4: Gas comparison calculator Milestone 5: Lead management and HubSpot integration Milestone 6: Testing, security and deployment
Freelancer Requirements
Please apply if you have experience with:
- Custom WordPress plugin development - PHP/MySQL - JavaScript - REST APIs - PDF processing - AI/OpenAI integrations - Calculation systems - WordPress security
Energy industry experience would be an advantage.
When Applying
Please provide:
- Examples of similar WordPress projects - Experience with PDF extraction - Experience with AI/API integrations - Estimated completion time - Fixed-price or milestone quote - Support offered after completion
Important: We require a proper calculation engine. The AI should not simply guess which electricity or gas plan is cheapest.
